column1: 'Cause I'm living my life like a good homo sapien

So I'm no better than the animals sitting in their cages
'Cause compared to the flowers and the birds and the trees
I think I'm so educated and I'm so civilized
But with the over-population and inflation and starvation
I don't feel safe in this world no more
I don't want to die in a nuclear war
I want to sail away to a distant shore and make like an ape man
'Cause compared to the sun that sits in the sky
Compared to the clouds as they roll by
Compared to the bugs and the spiders and flies
"In man's evolution he has created the city and the motor traffic rumble, but give me half a chance and I'd be taking off my clothes and living in the jungle."
'Cause the only time that I feel at ease
Is swinging up and down in a coconut tree
